verdict.rationale: Weave supports defining custom signals to tag/classify agent behavior and routing matched events to Slack notifications or webhook automations, which is a form of event-triggered rule automation (docs-17, docs-28, docs-36, docs-46). However, this is limited to a signals+alerts mechanism (classification -> notification/webhook) rather than a general rule/condition engine with arbitrary actions, and there's no independent or hands-on evidence validating real-world use of this feature. Missing for 10: evidence of a full conditional rule builder, broader action types beyond Slack/webhook, and independent/hands-on validation of the automation triggers working as described.
